research_notes: Follow-up: obtain substantive clinical FTE, leave and payroll/secondment evidence for each hospital; verify historical control and pay for US fellowships and university posts. Resolve 2021 CV leadership endpoints against APH's occupation through 2022; establish campaign leave/resignation and any private practice or paid expert work.

Reviewed both inquiry CVs, official biography, own career statements and RCH Foundation profile on 2026-09-29. These are public professional evidence; no medical opinions or patient facts were copied. The updated CV search found no full-time wording.

The CVs give overlapping training, academic and hospital appointments. Generic evidence notes refer to source locators; no title is treated as FTE proof. Clinical training is retained as potential employment, not automatically unpaid study. No duration calculated.

The updated CV also lists journal editing, grant review, teaching and professional governance. Their remuneration and employing relationships need follow-up; they are not automatically independent employment spells. Ongoing marks in an old CV are not extrapolated to the frozen 2026 snapshot. Last follow-up 2026-09-29; unresolved initial record.

2026-10-02 follow-up: found explicit individual full-time RCH description in6February2012 orientation notes, visually verified onp.2. No extension across all2006–2015/2008–2021 years or duplicate hours across clinic/staff roles. Re-read public inquiry professional appendix: late2021 RCH/MCRI resignation and honorary Monash professorship resolve earlier ambiguities. A2022 fellowship advert names Ryan as supervisor but its full-time wording describes the advertised fellow, not Ryan. Westmead2005 annual-report dataset download returned404; historical control/payroll for early hospitals and US fellowships still needs primary annual reports. Next: adjacent-year RCH staff lists/appointment and leave changes, early hospital annual reports, US fellowship contracts and private/expert work terms. No full-time years yet calculable; patient/case detail not retained.

2026-10-03 follow-up: Ryan's own campaign archive dates its Weekly Update to23December2021 and says she took her last RCH clinic 'yesterday' after resigning. The explicit date calculation places the final clinic on22December2021 and materially narrows the RCH endpoint to December2021. The record stores month precision because a last clinical session is not necessarily the contract/payroll cessation day. A16January2022 first-person update independently says she took a short break after resigning; no intervening paid role is inferred. RCH full-time status remains directly evidenced only on6February2012; leave, FTE changes, early hospital control/payroll and US fellowship terms remain unresolved, so no duration calculation.

2026-10-04 follow-up: narrow searches for full-time and appointment evidence found the already-recorded February2012 RCH full-time observation, dated publication affiliations and a 2022 fellowship position reporting to Ryan. None establishes Ryan's own continuous full-time status, leave or payroll boundaries. A contact aggregator displayed month-level dates copied from an unidentified profile, but it was not adopted because the underlying self-profile fields could not be independently retrieved and the aggregator also inaccurately implied ongoing RCH employment. Generic web search is exhausted for this pass; RCH/NSW hospital personnel records and appointment letters remain decisive. No substantive fact changed.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Re-inspected public professional appendix for omitted education and governance. Added qualifications, additional training and separate board terms, retaining unknown pay and any open endpoints rather than extending old CV entries. These are excluded activities; the two separated international research-board terms are not treated as continuous. Fellowship credential year differs between the appendix summary and detailed CV and remains an explicit follow-up gap. Other committee/registry, teaching, editing, author and expert-appointment remuneration and any independent payroll relationships still require investigation; professional activity is not automatically a separate job. No new personal hospital hours/leave evidence; 2012 full-time observation remains a point only.

2026-10-05 recovered original Westmead2005 employer report via government-linked Archive-It capture after legacy government PDF404 and web-reader archive InternalError. Ordinary download succeeded1052859bytes; text verified new Monique Ryan Senior Lecturer appointment p18/PDF21 and hospital legal reporting entity/state-sector consolidation p61/PDF64. Legal hospital name materially clarified; historical public control observed2005, full-period payroll/control verification remains explicit. Academic appointment corroborated without transferring adjoining Anne Morris part-time label or inferring separate/additive salaries. Personal hours/leave, early hospital boundaries,US fellowship contracts and paid expert work remain missing. No patient facts retained, no calculated duration.

Second targeted follow-up2026-10-05: original hospital2003 and NSW Health2005/06 financial records close boundary-year institutional control gap for staff-specialist2003–2006 spell, supplementing2005 report. Explicit state consolidation and departmental control support public classification without equating funding or nonprofit wording with ownership.2009 primary retrospective record identifies government-service personnel division from17March2006; personal transition/departure unverified. Early1992–1999 hospital control and US clinical-training payroll remain separate follow-ups; institution operating hours not assigned to Ryan. No personal full-time changes or leave found;2012 snapshot remains single observation, totals null.
